actions_or_findings.title: IA005-B1 CURRENT_TASK_BLOCKER: property lock can follow a stale cluster snapshot
actions_or_findings.trigger: Two analyses for one property overlap under MySQL REPEATABLE READ. Each reads content before waiting for the property lock.
actions_or_findings.rationale: The later plain cluster and link reads can retain the earlier snapshot after the lock is acquired. A threshold can be missed, or a committed link can appear absent and cause a duplicate-link failure. The saved run is sequential.

actions_or_findings.title: IA005-B2 CURRENT_TASK_BLOCKER: shared capacity charge can disappear
actions_or_findings.trigger: The charged primary assignment ends or times out while incident-follow assignments remain active.
actions_or_findings.rationale: Ending the primary decrements daily load; ending followers does not. The incident can therefore retain assigned reports without its shared capacity charge.

actions_or_findings.title: IA005-B3 CURRENT_TASK_BLOCKER: replacement can leave a stale primary
actions_or_findings.trigger: A supervisor reassigns the primary order, or its assignment times out before automatic replacement.
actions_or_findings.rationale: These paths leave the incident primary pointing to the former employee. A new member can follow that employee and bypass nominal capacity despite the changed or ended response.

actions_or_findings.title: IA005-B4 CURRENT_TASK_BLOCKER: nested rollback clears outer notification intents
actions_or_findings.trigger: An auto-dispatch SAVEPOINT rolls back after an outer transaction has buffered notification deliveries.
actions_or_findings.rationale: The new commit guard protects notification intents on SAVEPOINT release, but after_rollback still clears the entire outer pending list. The new event test checks incident rollback handling, not notification rollback handling.
